with latest_decisions as (select distinct on (canonical_product_id) * from feya_commerce_listing_master_decisions_v1 order by canonical_product_id,updated_at desc,created_at desc,id desc)
 select d.id,d.canonical_product_id,d.source_decision_id,d.h1,d.seo_title,d.review_status,d.status,d.reviewed_at,d.updated_at,d.archived_at,d.cqa_status,d.cqa_policy_version,

 l.manual_focus_json as current_focus, l.selected_keywords_json as selected_keywords
 from feya_commerce_v_seo_pack_drafts_latest_v1 v join feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d on d.id=v.id left join latest_decisions l on l.canonical_product_id=d.canonical_product_id::text order by d.canonical_product_id
